name: ccue
description: Private, on-device system-audio captions and translation for macOS
author: Terrence Wong <wongtk1997@gmail.com>

scripts.native:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml
scripts.renderer:check: node --check renderer/control.js && node --check renderer/model-availability.js && node --check renderer/overlay.js && node --check renderer/shortcut.js && node --check renderer/settings.js && node --check renderer/onboarding.js && node --check renderer/updater.js
scripts.check: npm run electron:check && npm run renderer:check
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run native:check && npm run local-asr:test && npm run local-translation:check
scripts.start: npm run native:build && npm run local-asr:build && npm run local-translation:build && npm run electron:build && electron .
scripts.build: npm run native:build && npm run local-asr:build && npm run local-translation:build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.dist: npm run native:build && npm run local-asr:build && npm run local-translation:build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.dist:release: npm run native:build && npm run local-asr:build && npm run local-translation:build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never --config.mac.forceCodeSigning=true

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: CCue captures system audio to generate captions on this Mac.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CCue may use audio input for future caption sources.
